kind: Recorded coupled circuit and mechanical example

before.note: First exchange, zero-back-EMF initial guess; not a converged solution.

after.scope: Declared 3 V maxon118743 ideal direct-drive disk model; two actual solver exchanges and explicit SI coupling consistency.
assumptions: Ideal direct drive. No gearbox loss, cogging, saturation or temperature variation.
Bearing and motor friction are omitted for this finite test; manufacturer no-load current does not uniquely determine static and viscous friction.
Rotor inertia is an axis-only armature; rotor spatial mass is not represented.
The rigid stop lug has negligible added mass/inertia compared with the specified disk.
Contact friction is zero; contact compliance is a chosen MuJoCo numerical model, not a validated material law.
Constant-torque input is a mechanical-only reference. A coupled result requires actual ngspice branch-current samples and back-EMF feedback, with numerical convergence checked.
No structural strength, thermal, fatigue, PWM-inductance, bearing-life or manufacturing-tolerance qualification.
limitations: Successive waveform convergence only; no timestep convergence or measured hardware validation.
Manufacturer constants and explicitly idealized disk/contact model only.

design_change: Driver resistance: 47 ohm -> 4.7 ohm. Final coupled consistency checked using two native exchanges.
representation: Public numerical extract, not the complete native trace package.
